example.context: Standard weekend admission before food, optional extras and unconfirmed fees; prices are not live quotes.

venues.name: Nixon’s Farm Play Barn
venues.price: £6 per child advertised online; booking page also contains conflicting £10 wording
venues.features: Bouncy castles, climbing frames and soft play in a farm setting.
venues.pick: Local active play with a tea room and animals nearby.
venues.caution: Outdoor garden is closed November–April; confirm full ticket cost and adult fee before paying.
venues.parent: Tea room; seating nearby; parking/changing/noise not assessed
venues.access: Socks required; wheelchair, accessible WC and quieter sessions not confirmed

venues.name: Head Over Heels Wilmslow
venues.booking: Book ahead; walk-ins subject to space
venues.features: Large frame, separate toddler area, pretend-play village, baby sensory room and disco.
venues.pick: Broadest documented range of play types within SK8 in this guide.
venues.caution: Two official pages disagree on prices: example family £29.88–£34.15 for 90 min. Electric cars cost extra; check checkout and height limit.
venues.parent: Restaurant, playside seating, Wi-Fi; two car parks, extra weekend parking; changing not assessed
venues.access: Disabled parking advertised; separate baby sensory room is not a SEND session; other access details unconfirmed
venues.review: One July 2026 Tripadvisor reviewer reported weekday parking difficulty; the venue responded with details of its two regular car parks and weekend overflow. This is an individual report, not an overall review judgement.

venues.name: Wild Things
venues.features: Large soft-play frame and Cafe Orinoco.
venues.pick: A conventional soft-play outing close to Cheadle Hulme.
venues.caution: Operator's about page quotes £9.50; a directory lists £8.50. Some site wording is old; verify checkout/session.
venues.parent: Café and table service; operator describes views and large car park; changing/noise unassessed
venues.access: Access and sensory sessions not confirmed; socks required

venues.name: Let Loose
venues.features: Main frame with elevated football area and obstacles, plus separate Toddler Town.
venues.pick: Mixed ages who want a larger frame and separate toddler space.
venues.caution: Arcade, go-karts and bear-making can cost extra; not for older teens.
venues.parent: Restaurant; seating sightlines, changing, parking and noise not assessed
venues.access: Toddler sensory equipment listed; specific SEND sessions/step-free access not confirmed

venues.name: Jump Heaven
venues.ages: Active children; check rules for little ones
venues.price: £15 online per child for 1 hour; 5 and under includes non-jumping adult
venues.features: Trampolines, climbing wall, slides and airbags.
venues.pick: For energetic children who want more than a standard frame.
venues.caution: Grip socks compulsory (£3 each if needed); supervision and age/waiver rules apply. Example £36 with two pairs of socks; adult participation extra.
venues.parent: Café; parking, sightlines, changing and noise not independently assessed
venues.access: Ask about individual access needs and session adjustments
venues.review: Recent Tripadvisor reviews examined include complaints about café cleanliness and supervision/payment confusion in 2025–26. These are reported experiences, not verified inspection findings. Confirm supervision rules before booking.

venues.name: Run of the Mill
venues.address: Pear Mill Industrial Estate, Stockport Road, SK6 2BP
venues.features: Baby zone for crawlers, ball pool, trampolines and slides.
venues.pick: Useful for siblings of different ages; weekday admission is lower.
venues.caution: Weekday example £14.50; no current session duration confirmed.
venues.parent: Café; seating, parking, changing and noise not assessed
venues.access: Dedicated 7–11 month zone; access and sensory provision unconfirmed

venues.name: Tumble Jacks
venues.price: Age 2 £8.50; age 5 £10; adults free; under 10 months free
venues.features: Indoor play with a café, no fixed session end and no adult admission fee.
venues.pick: A strong value/time choice and convenient if you dislike booking.
venues.caution: Check social updates for private hire or changed opening hours; older children may want more challenge.
venues.parent: Café; seating, parking, changing and ordinary noise not assessed
venues.access: Dedicated SEN sessions advertise reduced lights, no music and sensory toys; step-free and accessible WC unconfirmed
venues.review: A small Tripadvisor sample includes praise for staff and parties (2025–26), and one February 2025 report of a very busy half-term visit. Too few reviews for a confident overall judgement.

venues.name: The Place to Play
venues.price: Current full booking total not confirmed
venues.features: Over 12 pretend-play areas with a small café.
venues.pick: Children who enjoy shops, stories and imaginative play.
venues.caution: Not a large climbing-frame centre; cashless; front street parking limited to one hour.
venues.parent: Café; on-street parking at side/rear; baby changing confirmed; sightlines/noise unassessed
venues.access: Baby changing confirmed; step-free, accessible WC and quieter sessions unconfirmed

venues.name: Awesome Walls
venues.price: £30 family climbing for up to 3 eligible climbers (equipment included)
venues.session: 30 min instruction then stay and climb
venues.features: Roped climbing, bouldering and auto-belays in Pear Mill.
venues.pick: Older children and teens ready for a real climbing challenge.
venues.caution: The two- and five-year-old comparison does not apply. New climbers require instruction; confirm eligibility.
venues.parent: Refreshments and hangout areas; other parent facilities not assessed
venues.access: Ask the centre about individual needs and adaptive climbing

venues.name: Oxygen Activeplay Wilmslow
venues.price: Soft play £5.95 per toddler; supervising parents free; booking fee
venues.features: Toddler soft play, trampolines, sports and airbags.
venues.pick: Separate play options for younger and older children, not one shared ticket.
venues.caution: Two soft-play tickets total £11.90 plus booking fee; confirm suitability at age 5. Open play from £15.95 plus fee; separate rules. Register car on arrival.
venues.parent: Café and seating by soft play; free parking with registration; changing/noise unassessed
venues.access: Peaceful Play 4+ £9.95 includes eligible carer, per park timetable; access details unconfirmed

venues.name: Wacky Warehouse at Barlow Croft
venues.ages: Babies and younger children; check height
venues.price: £6 per child; adults and under-12-months free; term-time tots £4.50
venues.features: Pub-based indoor soft play with a tots area, slides and ball pools.
venues.pick: Low documented standard entry cost; combine with a meal if wanted.
venues.caution: Smaller-scale option than dedicated adventure parks; confirm age/height and visit length.
venues.parent: Café, free Wi-Fi and free onsite parking; seating/changing/noise unassessed
venues.access: Operator lists disabled facilities but specific access/WC details not confirmed

venues.name: Pure Imagination
venues.price: £10 child + adult; use ONLY1ADULT code for two children
venues.features: Pretend shops, fantasy scenes and jobs in a themed indoor play world.
venues.pick: Worth leaving SK8 for make-believe rather than another climbing frame.
venues.caution: Two tickets cost £20 before the one-adult code; actual discount not confirmed.
venues.parent: Café and operator-described visibility; nearby two-hour free parking; noise/changing unassessed
venues.access: Operator confirms wheelchair access and accessible toilet; sensory sessions unconfirmed

venues.name: Curious Little Ones
venues.features: Montessori-inspired wooden toys, pre-walker area, creative play and books.
venues.pick: A different pace from climbing frames, especially for babies and younger siblings.
venues.caution: Not designed for children who want a big physical adventure; Saturday listed closed on booking page, confirm hours.
venues.parent: Café, baby changing and open-plan design; parking and actual noise not assessed
venues.access: Operator confirms wheelchair access and accessible WC; quieter design is not a guarantee of low noise

venues.name: Little World for Scholars
venues.price: £9.95 child including adult; pre-walkers free with paying ticket
venues.features: Small themed play den where children create their own stories.
venues.pick: A different option for preschool pretend play near the town centre.
venues.caution: Limited pram space; extra adult charge differs between FAQ and price page; confirm if relevant.
venues.parent: Coffee shop; baby changing reported by Visit Altrincham; no dedicated parking confirmed; sightlines/noise unassessed
venues.access: Wheelchair access and accessible toilet confirmed by operator

venues.name: Play Factore
venues.features: Large indoor frame with a long slide, separate toddler area and optional zip wire.
venues.pick: Worth a longer journey for scale and older siblings.
venues.caution: Peak family example £36.15–£41.15; off-peak £32.15; optional zip wire £4.95 and arcade extras.
venues.parent: Parent comfort, parking, changing and noise not independently assessed
venues.access: Separate toddler area; accessibility and sensory sessions unconfirmed

picks: Varied play in one SK8 venue; confirm the conflicting published price.
A play barn and farm setting in Heald Green.
£12 for our example family, with adults free; compare session length.
Stay as long as you like
£18.50 for the example family, walk-in only and unlimited time.
Separate pre-walker area and baby ticket; a quieter style of play.
Over 12 role-play areas in Reddish; check ticket price.
Instructor-led climbing from age six; not a toddler venue.
Reduced lighting, music switched off and sensory toys at dedicated sessions.

updates.detail: Initial desk-research guide: 15 venues; conflicting prices and incomplete review evidence marked. Not a site inspection.
